registry.item_title: Total Number of Antibiotic-associated Diarrhea Episodes

item_title_witness.text: Total Number of Antibiotic-associated Diarrhea Episodes

notes: Selected the primary registry measure Total Number of Antibiotic-associated Diarrhea Episodes. Events are episodes, not necessarily distinct affected participants; denominators are registry Participants counts. The article Table 4 separately reports ITT participants with exactly one episode (21 intervention, 15 placebo) and exactly two episodes (0 intervention, 2 placebo), with denominators 246 and 231; PP counts are 16 and 11 with one episode, 0 and 2 with two episodes, with denominators 146 and 146. These categories were not summed. Other registry outcomes include AAD episodes without evidence of Clostridium difficile toxins (19 and 17; denominators 246 and 231), C. difficile-associated diarrhea episodes (2 and 2; denominators 246 and 231), and AAD incidence density (0.78 and 0.64 cases per year, not counts). The adverse-events module also reports the nonspecific term Diarrhoea (1/245 and 0/222), which is less specific than the primary AAD outcome.
